name: GitHub
summary: Reference connector. Read-only repository metadata access via fine-grained PAT or GitHub App. Source of truth for the Heiwa connector contract.
revocation_path: Revoke fine-grained PAT at https://github.com/settings/tokens or uninstall the GitHub App from https://github.com/settings/installations. App owners can also revoke installation tokens via the REST API.

source_notes.title: GitHub REST API permissions for fine-grained PATs
Creating a fine-grained personal access token
About authentication with a GitHub App

capabilities.description: Read repository metadata (name, description, default branch, visibility, topics, archived state). No code, issues, PRs, or Actions data.
capabilities.permission_notes: Fine-grained PAT scope 'Repository permissions -> Metadata: Read-only', which is the minimum scope required by GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}.
capabilities.rate_hint: Authenticated REST primary rate limit applies.
